{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (3–4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]]) whole broiler/fryer [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], cut into serving pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]]
* 1 tbsp dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 1 tbsp dried [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]] flakes
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] chicken pieces with olive oil. Set aside.
#Combine all remaining ingredients and rub into chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Heat about 28 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Disperse evenly around bottom of grill and reapply the grate.
#Add chicken and cook, turning often, until internal temperature of the breast is 165°F and the thigh is 170°F.
#Remove to a plate and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]]. Let rest 10 minutes before serving warm.
